create_obstructed_maze_env: create an ObstructedMazeEnv instance with custom rows, columns, and rooms visited parameters
run_obstructed_maze_full: run the ObstructedMaze_Full 3x3 maze environment with locked doors and hidden keys in boxes
test_obstructed_maze_1Dlhb: test the ObstructedMaze_1Dlhb 2x1 maze environment with locked doors, blocking balls, and keys in boxes
create_obstructed_maze_quarter: create an ObstructedMaze_1Q or ObstructedMaze_2Q environment with one or two quarters of a 3x3 maze
review_add_door_method: review the ObstructedMazeEnv add_door method that adds doors with optional locks, keys in boxes, and blocking balls
